data.name: Naughty Nurse
data.detailed_description:
Fan made game inspired by the game 'Lunch Lady' by 'Manic Mice'. Medical bills are coming due, and the cost of healthcare has risen. Run through several haunted locations to collect the bills, but be careful. A murderous nurse will try to stop you from escaping, giving you a wide variety of effects. Will you live, will you escape? It's up to you, her mood, and your ability to run and hide.

This game is in Early Access and will receive decently regular updates, features, and bug fixes. It is a living project, so new mechanics, map changes, and abilities will be introduced and tested over time.

Currently, the developer is learning the multiplayer API for integration, so early playtests and the first few Early Access releases will be Single Player only.

Features Currently In Development:
-Settings Menu And Controls
-Multiplayer Support

-5th New Map

This is the developer's first game and is over a year in the making. Please try to make feedback constructive so it can improve over time.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 or New-Gen i3 / AMD Equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: ATI HD7900 series or NVIDIA Equivalent.
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit Required

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
